verdict.rationale: First-party docs say self-hosting runs the complete Flagsmith platform on your own infrastructure (flagsmith-docs-12). They also document a Docker setup for an entire Flagsmith environment (flagsmith-docs-13, flagsmith-docs-27) and a self-hosted Edge Proxy (flagsmith-docs-14, flagsmith-docs-28), with the source on a public GitHub repo (flagsmith-gh-1). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, evidence of an open-source license and feature parity between self-hosted and SaaS editions, and production-grade hosting guides beyond local Docker.
